akitaDAO.descr: the app ID of the Akita DAO

boxCount.descr: the number of boxes created during the poll

endTime.descr: the time the poll ends as a unix timestamp

funder.descr: the poll's creator and its creation deposit; the factory refunds the deposit to whoever paid it

gateID.descr: the gate id to be used for filtering who can interact with this poll

maxSelected.descr: the maximum number of selections in a multiple choice poll

optionCount.descr: the number of options in the poll

optionOne.descr: the options and vote counts of the poll

type.descr: The type of poll: SingleChoice, MultipleChoice, SingleChoiceImpact or MultipleChoiceImpact

version.descr: the current version of the contract

votesOne.descr: the number of votes for each option

methods.name: deleteBoxes
methods.desc:
Remove vote boxes after the poll has ended and return each voter's deposit.

Only the poll's creator may do this: the account that called the factory's `new`, which the
factory records as `funder.account` whoever paid for the poll (AUD-C24). The vote boxes are what
`hasVoted` reads, and PollGate passes or fails people on it, so when a poll's record of who
voted disappears is the creator's decision and nobody else's (readiness audit 2026-11-09,
C17). Each deposit goes back to whoever paid it, the voter unless someone else funded the vote,
and never to the caller.
